name: Stekljannaja shesterjonka
source:
It's cold. It's cold, you hardly feel your own body lying on a wet stone pavement. What awaits you behind the impending, impenetrable darkness?..
Maybe it was a bad idea to run away from the orphanage. To think that they would survive in any conditions. Because now they are lying in an abandoned alley, starving to death.
But what if this is not the end? What if fate did not prepare for them a painful death, but something much more terrible?
Metal walls. A web of wires reaching for bright screens. Sharp glare on long thin needles. People in white coats, bright light. Dark hair, arm extended forward. Blindingly white eyes that see through you.
Object number 4217.
Can you find out where you ended up after your body fell on a cold pavement?
Can you solve all the mysteries of this place?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
是冷的。天气很冷，你几乎感觉不到自己的身体躺在湿漉漉的石路上。即将到来的、无法穿透的黑暗背后等待着你的是什么呢？
也许逃离孤儿院不是一个好主意。认为他们在任何条件下都能生存。因为现在他们正躺在废弃的小巷里，快要饿死了。
但如果这还没有结束怎么办？如果命运没有为他们准备痛苦的死亡，而是更可怕的事情呢？
金属墙。电线网伸向明亮的屏幕。细长的针上发出锐利的眩光。人们穿着白大褂，灯光明亮。深色头发，手臂向前伸展。一双白得让人眼花缭乱的眼睛，能看穿你。
对象编号4217。
当你的身体跌倒在冰冷的人行道上后，你能找出你最终去了哪里吗？
你能解开这个地方的所有谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761040/]Steam[/url]]
